issuer.name: Harmoniie SAS (ACPR, CIB 17478) with Moorwand Ltd under a Mastercard licence

funding.supported_assets_note: No separate card balance: spending is deducted from the Bybit EU Funding Account. Supported: EUR and USDC, BTC, ETH, MNT, GRAM, XRP, EURC with a user-set payment priority; crypto converted at spend with a 0.9% conversion fee.

eligibility.usage_note: Official FAQ (updated 2026-10-02) lists 29 supported EEA countries and states 'Malta is excluded'. Applications may be declined at Bybit EU's discretion.

kyc.stages_note: Card application requires its own, 'more stringent' identity verification even if the Bybit EU account is verified: EEA national ID, passport, residence permit (≥6 months validity) or driving licence. Proof of address is required only when the identity document is not from an EEA country (FAQ 2026-10-02). Billing address, mobile number and security questions must be completed before online/overseas transactions.

fees.conditions: Virtual card: no fee. Physical card: first issuance free 'until further notice', replacement 5 EUR (fee schedule 2026-10-08). The landing page states $5 / 5 USDC for the physical card — contradiction shown.

Fees & Limits schedule (2026-10-08): 0.5% on top of Mastercard's rate, FX padding 0%. The card landing page FAQ says 1%; the dated fee schedule is the governing document and is modelled; contradiction shown.
0.9% on top of Bybit EU's One-Click Sell rate for transactions funded with non-fiat assets; minimum conversion 1 EUR/USD.
2% after the first 100 EUR each month (fee schedule 2026-10-08 and FAQ 2026-10-02; the landing page says $100). ATM operators may add their own fees.
Spends from the Funding Account; no separate top-up fee stated (deposit/purchase fees on the exchange side not covered).

rewards.conditions: 1% cashback on eligible spending, no monthly cap. Payout asset not stated on this page (a January 2026 press release mentions Bitcoin cashback; not verified on an official page).
VIP tiers earn 2%–10% subject to monthly caps; VIP status depends on Bybit's VIP programme (trading volume/assets), details on the Rewards page not read.

New-user welcome package: 'up to €120 cashback in your first 30 days', first month of eligible subscriptions refunded up to €50, trading-fee vouchers. T&Cs apply; no end date stated; maximum, not a guaranteed amount.

limits.note: Tier 1: 5,000 EUR per transaction and per day, 10,000/month, 60,000/year; Tier 2 (upgrade on request): 10,000/day, 25,000/month; Tier 3 (VIP): 15,000/day, 50,000/month.
Physical card: 2,000 EUR per transaction and per day; 2,000/5,000/10,000 per month by tier.

evidence.title: Bybit Card EU product page + FAQ (browser read; page renders client-side)
evidence.excerpt: Eligibility: ID Verification Lv.2 + EEA proof of address <3 months. Fees FAQ: FX 1% over Mastercard rate; crypto conversion 0.9% + spot fees; annual/inactivity/cancellation none; virtual issuance none, physical $5; ATM 2% after $100/month free. Cashback 1% uncapped; VIP 2–10% with monthly caps. Welcome: up to €120 in 30 days. Issuer Harmoniie SAS / Moorwand, Mastercard.

editorial.summary: Mastercard debit card of Bybit EU (issued by Harmoniie SAS, France) for EEA residents: no annual fee, 1% uncapped cashback from day one, 1% FX fee and 0.9% crypto conversion fee; VIP tiers earn more with caps.
good_for: EEA residents who already trade on Bybit EU
Simple 1% cashback without holding a platform token
not_for: Spending crypto directly without accepting a 0.9% conversion fee on top of trading fees
Anyone who needs the cashback asset and VIP caps confirmed before choosing
watch_outs: Payout asset of the cashback is not stated on the card page.
Welcome offer is 'up to' amounts with unspecified terms and no end date.
ATM allowance and physical card fee are stated in USD on a EUR product page.
